Gifted: Extra Limbs.name: Gifted: Extra Limbs
Gifted: Extra Limbs.description:
🧬 Extra Limbs, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Each starts about as strong as an ordinary arm: climb, carry and fight with all at once, strike from angles one guard cannot cover, and pin a person with your hands free.
📈 With training: several injured carried, an eye or ear budded at a limb tip, sprints up walls, a falling ceiling held, a group seized, limbs split among separate tasks.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as muscle tears where the limbs join.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mezo Shoji (Dupli-Arms).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Extra Limbs.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Extra Limbs family): Scale: born with extra limbs of the player's choice: a second pair of arms, up to about four back or shoulder tentacles, or long prehensile limbs. Each has an adult arm's strength; together they lift about two adults' weight, hands left free. Larger feats need techniques. Limits: blades cut and blows break them, and each is one more thing to grab or pin. They cannot stretch, detach or regrow; grips slip past a few holds at once. Always visible unless covered; strangers stare; clothes and costumes need custom work. Quirk Strain: none for daily use; light: multi-limb strike, bind; moderate: group carry, budded organ, fast climb; heavy: bracing a structure, seizing a group; severe: signature move, splitting limbs among tasks. Type: Mutant. Law: striking, pinning or carrying off a person with the limbs unlicensed is assault or unlawful restraint outside self-defense.
